$comment: NB 2.1 art spec for the Coin Cosmetics Boutique avatars. Paint with: node art/wavespeed.mjs boutique-avatar --backend gemini
lead: Paint a square fantasy character bust portrait.
style: Painterly fantasy character bust portrait in oil and gouache on a dark atmospheric background: warm directional key light, expressive silhouette centered for a circular medallion crop, visible brushwork.
rules: Center the character's head and shoulders cleanly for a circular avatar crop with generous breathing room around the edges. No frames, rings, text or symbols.
